# ManO CreationS — Extended public website reference

Website: https://www.manocreations.com/
Brand: ManO CreationS
Founder: Manoj Thiruchelvam, Founder and Creative Director
Founded: 2016
Founder base: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
Email: ceo@manocreations.com
Public contact phone: +91 81247 99703
Public WhatsApp: +91 90803 54580

## About
ManO CreationS is a creative design studio offering logo design, branding, marketing graphics, packaging, business stationery, catalogues and brochures. It describes its approach as design that performs, not just looks good. The published workflow is Brief, Concepts, Refine, Deliver.

## Published services and starting prices (verify live pages before quoting)
- Logo design: from INR 1,499
- Brand identity: from INR 7,999
- Digital marketing design: from INR 199
- Packaging design: from INR 2,499
- Business stationery: from INR 399
- Catalogues & brochures: from INR 299 per page (services page); see pricing page for individual products and rates.
Pricing may change. https://www.manocreations.com/services.html and https://www.manocreations.com/pricing.html are authoritative.

## Founder biography
Manoj Thiruchelvam is a mechanical engineering graduate of Anna University. He began experimenting with graphics during secondary school, founded ManO CreationS in 2016 and developed its visual identity. His biography describes work across more than 20 industrial companies in Tamil Nadu, including Lakshmi Machine Works and Propel Industries. https://www.manocreations.com/about-founder.html

## Accuracy and limitations
Do not claim endorsements or work performed for third-party brands based solely on logos on the portfolio page. Do not attribute Kiruthika Industries steel fabrication services to ManO CreationS. Product availability, rates and turnaround times should be checked on the live pages.
